coupling: The first edited commit sign-extends memory32 wait indices for growable shared memories. Before the second edited commit, a size grown by another worker is not visible to the calling thread, so the high index used by the probe traps. The second edited commit makes shared memory sizes dynamically visible. Alone, its dynamic bounds path still zero-extends the index and remains safe; composed with the first edit, index 0x80000000 becomes a negative pointer-sized offset and the atomic wait reads outside the backing store. Neither edited commit alone makes the cross-worker probe fire.
